statusVocabulary.implemented-unverified: Code written and reviewed, but not yet executed in the current verification gate. Makes no claim of working until the test run is recorded.
statusVocabulary.verified: Covered by a passing automated test that exercises the stage named.
statusVocabulary.partial: Works for a stated subset; the limitation is recorded in `limitations`.
statusVocabulary.n/a: Not applicable at this stage for this capability.

framing.note: Under this architecture, LaTeX syntax support is not an application feature — TeX Live 2026 parses and typesets the document, so the parser/semantic/layout stages for LaTeX constructs are the engine's, not ours.
soWhatIsTracked: Engine capabilities we invoke and must configure correctly without altering user source.
Application capabilities: mounting, display, export, synchronisation, diagnostics, and Supabase RLS isolation.
Package-set availability and transitive dependency prefetching.
The React Structure panel (sections, labels, figures, tables, citations).
framing.honesty: A capability is `verified` only where a named automated test has been executed and passed against the current CodeMirror 6 / Stage 1 build. Stage 1 verification gate has passed (tsc clean, oxlint clean, 114 vitest unit/fuzz tests, 9 playwright e2e tests passing).

capabilities.capability: Log-driven repeat passes to settle cross-references, TOC and labels
capabilities.spec: Re-runs while parseTexLog(log).rerunRequired is true, up to MAX_COMPILE_PASSES = 3
limitations: Capped at 3 total passes per compile; if rerunRequired remains true after pass 3, PreviewPane surfaces a warning banner.

capabilities.capability: Parallel transitive package dependency prefetch into MEMFS
capabilities.spec: preloadDocumentPackages() scans .sty/.cls/.def/.cfg/.tex/.clo/.fd up to depth 4 (max 160 files)
limitations: Macro-constructed package names cannot be statically extracted and fall back to synchronous XHR in kpathsea.

capabilities.capability: Row-level security on projects, checkpoints, and profiles
limitations: Requires applying 0001_rls_ownership.sql and rotating keys in the Supabase dashboard.

capabilities.capability: Render the compiled PDF with windowed canvas lifecycle
capabilities.spec: pdf.js 6.4.299, local worker, canvas/text-layer release on deactivation

capabilities.capability: Clickable PDF annotation and link layer
capabilities.spec: PDF.js 6.4 Link annotations with viewport coordinate transform, internal TOC/ref/cite navigation, strict protocol whitelisting (http, https, mailto)

capabilities.capability: React structural outline panel (sections, labels, figures, tables, citations)
capabilities.spec: PreviewPane StructurePanel rendered as React elements from ParsedDocument and LatexLabel[]
limitations: Structural navigation only; does not approximate layout or pagination.

capabilities.capability: W3C DTCG 3-tier design token architecture and accessibility system

capabilities.capability: WAI-ARIA 1.2+ Command Palette Combobox and Listbox
